notes: Questions created in the calendar month (UTC), counted from the /2.3/questions endpoint with filter total. Counts are as of the fetch date, so questions deleted later are not included. The current month is excluded; the last two complete months are refetched on every run. Site: stackoverflow, from September 2008.
